name: app-69e2c94588808191a7554cf2ac04b7c8
description: Search current Boat Trader new and used boats for sale across the U.S.

interface.longDescription: Search, compare and research new and used boats for sale across the U.S. using current Boat Trader marketplace inventory. Find listings by make, model, location, price, size, year, condition, seller type, engines and equipment, see photos and asking prices, open a listing's full details, and research how many boats are available and current asking-price ranges. Boat Trader is strongest for U.S. inventory, local boat shopping, dealer listings and private-party listings.
defaultPrompt: Show me Grady White Canyon boats
Show me boats listed in the last 7 days

positive.description: Search listings by type and price
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current Boat Trader trawler listings under $300,000 with photos, asking prices and listing links.

positive.description: Search listings by make and model
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current Boat Trader listings for the Grady-White Canyon model.

positive.prompt: Show me boats listed in the last 7 days
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Boat Trader listings listed in the last 7 days.

positive.prompt: How many sailboats are available under $200k?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many sailboats are listed under $200,000 with the asking-price range, without showing a list of boats.

positive.prompt: Show me center console boats in Florida, then show me the details for the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Lists center console boats in Florida, then shows the first listing's details, photos and specifications.

negative.description: Weather question outside the app's scope
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any of the app's tools.

negative.description: Writing task outside the app's scope
negative.prompt: Help me write a cover letter
negative.expected_behavior: Helps with the cover letter without calling any of the app's tools.

negative.description: General engineering explanation, not a listing search
negative.expected_behavior: Explains diesel engines without calling any of the app's tools.

publication.release_notes: Packages the existing Boat Trader remote MCP server (https://boattrader-mcp.live.boatsgroup.com/mcp, server version 0.1.30, already live) for plugin submission. No backend change ships with this package.
